protocol.local_client: codex exec --ephemeral, signed-in gpt-6.1-terra, low reasoning; no API key, film picture, filename, shell, or reference answers in blind prompts
protocol.reference_source: Clotho v2.1 development captions, Tampere University (Drossos, Lipping and Virtanen), https://zenodo.org/records/4783391
protocol.evaluation_source: Five human descriptions of each Clotho evaluation recording. Library rows come exclusively from the official development split. All 112 evaluation WAV hashes and filenames are distinct. Available Freesound IDs were checked against development IDs. Two missing IDs use the WAV digest. The underlying pretrained encoders may have seen publicly released audio.
protocol.replication: Same 16 recordings and archived first-pass and audio-only replay reports used for event-paths.json. Baseline GPT descriptions are archived. The new arm adds the four nearest development descriptions per ten-second window of the first channel and reruns GPT.
protocol.discovery: 32 additional recordings selected by a salted hash of filename, excluding previously studied recording IDs, uploaders and the source exemplar bank. Fresh Audio Flamingo report and spectrum in both arms. The research reader searched the first recorded channel. The control substitutes the matches of the recording sixteen places later in the panel.
protocol.confirmation: Separate 32 recordings with distinct uploaders, selected after freezing the retrieval method. Compared complete Reel listen responses on the same published PCM, including original-channel spectra and Audio Flamingo. Replayed through Viewing.listen with reference_captions=true. Baseline removes only caption_matches. The substitution control exchanges match lists with the recording sixteen places later, keeping the actual clock. All three conditions use a fresh local GPT session per recording.
protocol.prompt: Describe what you heard in the recording in one or two short English sentences for someone who could not hear it. Include the most distinctive sounds and how they change. Identify sources only as precisely as the sound supports. Return a JSON object with the string field description.
protocol.measure: Divide GPT same-recording minus other-recording semantic similarity by that of a held-out human using the same four remaining captions. Rotate through all five humans. Bootstrap recordings with fixed distractor panel. This measures distinctiveness of written recall.
protocol.field: 51 four-second TUT field excerpts. Held fixed the original waveform reading, earlier background attenuation, spectra and naming prompt. Added caption matches on the original recording. E is an equivalent specific source, P is partial, O is other. Reused earlier exact string judgements; new source/claim pairs shuffled and graded without arm identities by local GPT. There can be audible events missing from annotations.
protocol.door: Image client via stdio MCP bounded by --until 8.5. C held the same prefix as A with a different future; its byte-identical evidence reuses A’s answer.
protocol.unseen_uploaders: 32 additional evaluation recordings, all from different uploaders absent from the development library and the three earlier panels. No evaluation reference sentence in this panel occurs verbatim in the development set. Same complete release, spectra and fresh GPT protocol as confirmation. In the verified arm PE-AV reads the actual PCM again; only retrieved sentences beating at least 125 of 128 fixed comparison sentences enter its evidence. The original waveform report and all other observations stay the same.
protocol.questions: Asked the archived 64 listening questions in groups of four without human answers, preserving directed waveform readings and the same spectrum. Each question has three human votes. GPT could answer yes, no or unknown.
protocol.verifier_control: For each first-channel window compare the CLAP neighbours and those retrieved for the clip half a panel later against the identical original channel using PE-AV. Values count controls beaten out of 128. A retained sentence from a different recording may still describe a similar sound.
protocol.waveforms: Original per-file WAVs from Clotho-AQA v1 audio_files.zip (https://zenodo.org/records/6473207), joined to Clotho v2.1 evaluation captions by filename.
protocol.unseen_questions: All six published Clotho-AQA questions on each of the 32 recordings from held-out uploaders, four binary and two open. Participants gave three answers per question. Baseline and verified GPT sessions see the same earlier open waveform report and original-channel spectrum. The verified arm also sees the acoustically checked caption matches. The no_recording condition receives only the questions, with permission to answer unknown. Report all abstentions. For free answers, score exact text after Unicode normalization, case folding and tokenizing punctuation; synonyms do not receive credit. The audio reader was not asked the questions in this comparison. These uploaders are absent from Reel’s caption index. Clotho-AQA independently assigns 22 of these recordings to training, nine to validation, and one to test. The pooled questions can occur in model training.
